title: Elysara
author: AmazingTea1559
selftext:
**Introducing Elysara – A project I've been working on for nearly a year!**

Elysara is a strategy game set in another realm, where the gods have been forced to flee their own world after it was consumed by a mysterious force known as the Blight.

Now, in a new realm, the gods must rebuild their power, establish civilisations and compete for control of entire worlds and the galaxy 

There will be 4 playable Divine factions at launch, each with its own identity, units, abilities and playstyle, with another 17 Divines to follow.
